contracts.boundary: deterministic acceptance validator with real local Git fixture; not Pi generation
contracts.assertions: Every changed file is mapped; named completed events are unique and passed; absent or stale metadata fails closed.

boundaryTest.name: checks real git diff and fails closed for missing PR metadata or declaration

invariant.name: rejects missing ambiguous failed skipped TODO and nonterminal evidence

fault.name: the missing-case assertion detects a disabled execution guard
